 **只用主克隆的 linked worktree**：lane、席位、交付与研究树都由主检出所在的克隆经 `make worktree` 建立，不另建 git 克隆（含浅克隆、本地路径克隆与“独立 dev 根”）。缓存的自动 donor 只在本克隆内寻找（linked worktree 克隆其所在克隆主检出的 `.lake`）；未用 `STRATALINT_LEAN_CACHE_DONOR_REPOSITORY` 显式指定 donor 时，额外克隆的主检出会另取一份独立的 `.lake`（Release 恢复或重新构建），与主克隆不共享 clonefile 块；`clean-lanes` 与 `clean-all` 只回收本克隆登记的 worktree，额外克隆及其 worktree 不在回收范围内。需要隔离时，在主克隆上另开 linked worktree，并用 `StrataLint worktree with` 声明作用域。
 
-Idle retention and eviction use the single pool owner in SPEC A20. All registered worktree cleanup follows SPEC A20/A20.1: after main/nested registration, identity and native-operation qualification, a linked tree is selected when its observed HEAD committer Unix time (`%ct`) is at least 24 hours old. This includes idle, detached and non-managed branch trees. Selection does not depend on allocation time, reflog history, merge status, ordinary dirty status or commits behind BASE. Author time, directory timestamps, reads, checkout/reset and reflog operations do not renew the last commit. Missing or unreadable commit time retains with update_unknown and concrete detail; a future clock retains with age_unverifiable. Intentional locks require at least 24 hours since Git lock-file modification; a worktree-init: initialization marker requires an acquired exclusive tree scope and a busy initializer retains with initialization_in_progress. Verified interrupted removals retain their existing resume path. Younger idle trees use the capacity/disk-pressure owner; expired idle paths are excluded from that pool invocation and follow the same commit-age removal as other trees. FORCE reobserves tip, branch, registration, lock and Git directory and recomputes selection before removal; changed observations retain with race_changed. Named removal bypasses automatic age selection. Before removal, checkpoint outstanding ordinary changes using the real index. Each warning names path, action, reason and diagnostic; preview follows the same rule. Policy retention, including commit-age grace, the main checkout, current intentional locks, live initialization, nested registration and idle capacity, emits no warning. Per-tree outcomes and individual deletion failures in independent sweeps retain their observed effects, warn and continue with a successful aggregate exit. Global failures retain their nonzero exit and sweep deferral. Clean-lanes performs no branch sweep or retirement; idle-pool return and claim retain their own idle-marker branch bookkeeping. Without explicit remover --force, content deletion and unregistration share 1800 seconds; clean-lanes allows 2100 seconds for that subprocess. Clean trees need no empty commit. Ignored files and intermediate staged versions are outside snapshot recovery. General activity inspection, cwd, programs, participation and cache use do not govern ordinary deletion; initialization liveness and blocked-checkpoint or initialization native-lock recovery use only the scoped checks above. Ordinary removal does not require remote confirmation; merged-task return and idle eligibility follow their specific remote-dev rules. Native branch checkout reconstructs the committed snapshot while its ref and reachable objects remain intact. Non-worktree artifacts retain independent policies.
